WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(o.amount) AS average_amount
    FROM `order` AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE o.amount > 2802
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS overall_average
    FROM group_averages
)
SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.average_amount,
       g.average_amount - overall.overall_average AS difference
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE g.average_amount > overall.overall_average
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
